name: 28103-1k1k-qwen3-0.6b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1; one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 25% by completion, bounded at 128 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, prompt exactly 1024 tokens and output exactly 1024 with ignore_eos, temperature 1.0, no top_p/top_k/seed. The chat template adds a flat 8 tokens, so the wire prompt reads 1032.
purpose: A small-model writing assistant drafting page-length replies from page-length prompts for eight concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# One Qwen3-0.6B engine on one H100, eager, driven at eight concurrent streams over a
# 1024-token prompt and a 1024-token generation. Values are written down rather than left to
# resolve so the engine cannot silently pick a different one.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# LOAD-BEARING: this item is declared over the EAGER execution path. A compiled run completes and
# reports a healthy number for a path the item is not declared over -- do not substitute one.
enforce-eager: true

max-num-seqs: 256
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# LOAD-BEARING: this engine turns prefix caching ON by default. Forced off so every request does
# its own prefill; at a 1024-token prompt an accidental prefix hit would remove real prefill work.
enable-prefix-caching: false
